title: Debiasing Neural Retrieval via In-batch Balancing Regularization

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring ranking disparity and retrieval bias using metrics like |∆A-PRF| (difference over averaged Pairwise Ranking Fairness) and RaB@k (Ranking Bias at top k). These metrics evaluate the difference in the frequency and magnitude of male versus female definitional words within passages retrieved for non-gendered queries.
